about: Boxes for the three application photos whose objects have no COCO class, so no detector in this lecture can find them. Cells: a colour threshold against the slide's background and connected components, with the one touching pair split by eye. Parcel: a colour threshold on the cardboard, checked by eye. Crack: drawn by eye on a 5x zoom of the arm. These are annotations, the kind of list a detector for these classes would be trained on, not model outputs.
